secrets.name: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key (pk_test_ or pk_live_) from the Clerk dashboard → API Keys. Used by the Express API server.

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key (sk_test_ or sk_live_) from the Clerk dashboard → API Keys. Used by the Express API server to verify auth tokens.

secrets.name: VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Same Clerk publishable key as CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, prefixed with VITE_ so Vite exposes it to the frontend. Required — the React app throws at startup without it.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_ or sk_live_) from https://dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → API Keys. Used by the API server to create checkout sessions and verify webhooks.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) from https://dashboard.stripe.com → Developers → Webhooks (or from `stripe listen --forward-to` when using Stripe CLI locally).

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_BUYER_PRO
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID for the Buyer Pro plan ($79/month). Create a Product + recurring Price in https://dashboard.stripe.com → Products, then copy the price_ ID.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_PROFESSIONAL
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID for the Professional plan ($149/month). Create in Stripe Dashboard → Products and copy the price_ ID.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_PRIVATE_NETWORK
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID for the Private Network plan ($299/month). Create in Stripe Dashboard → Products and copy the price_ ID.
